officialSource: make.fun competition kit • PlayStation trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies in single-player. Put the Chapter 1 meditation on your route before starting the long cleanup. There is no multiplayer or DLC requirement.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Follow the main story out of the prologue and finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. The trophy is automatic; there is no separate medal or bonus objective.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep playing into Chapter 2. PowerPyx places the unlock after What’s in the Bag?, so a chapter transition without a trophy notification is not a reason to restart.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue past the end of Chapter 2 and clear Welcome to Vice City, the first main mission of Chapter 3. The chapter trophy is tied to that story checkpoint.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Carry on into Chapter 4 and finish both Ocean Beach and Another Life. Expect the notification after the second of those missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Starting From Zero. PowerPyx lists this as the unlock point for both this bronze and the story gold, so check for two trophies at the same checkpoint.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Follow the main mission chain through Starting From Zero, the unlock PowerPyx lists for this gold. Keep going through the remaining story content for Snow Storm and the post-story checklist.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Continue the Chapter 2 main missions after Daily Driver until Breakfast Run is available. Finish it normally; Coffee Break is a separate mission and is not this trophy's trigger.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3’s main heist, The Cartel Heist. The separate free-roam bank vault jobs count toward Maximum Withdrawal, not this story unlock.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Advance Chapter 4 until the mission to rescue Rafa appears, then finish Child’s Play. It is an automatic main-story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Look for the launch-party assignment in Chapter 4. Follow Headliners through to its story completion; there is no separate activity to find afterward.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown during Chapter 4. This comes from the story mission itself, separate from the free-roam airport departure trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Continue into Chapter 5 and clear Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx classifies the trophy as automatic, so no optional objective is needed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Earlier progress carries over. Aim for 100 optional tasks, 200 base-model scans and 100 animal studies as you play. Then use the roadmap’s full checklist to finish every required quota; you do not need to clear every world icon.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Mix jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are a good way to raise the total quickly. A successful stunt counts without its extra challenge. Check Progress → Activities → Stunts; keep going to 300 for game completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Check Progress → Activities against nine entries: fish, hunt, play golf, visit a shooting range, play pool, score a basketball hoop, play a video game, win a race and perform a stunt. A drone race win can fill the racing slot.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Buy the $5 waiver at each range. Clear 18 golds at Griffin in northwest Vice City and 24 at Rodgers Ranch northeast of Port Gellhorn. For Griffin’s timed courses, keep moving between targets; at Rodgers, protect your score multiplier. Rentals are enough.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Under Map → Activities → Top Fun Drones, visit each site and beat par on at least one trial. Dalton Island needs a boat or aircraft. For 100%, beat par on the first two runs at each site and finish the third, even if over par.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Use Progress → Activities → Racing to count distinct wins. Try Billy’s Mud Club in Kelly County in Chapter 2 and Hit ’N Run VC after Dealer’s Choice in Chapter 3. Play each site’s events to unlock later races. Aim for 30 wins if also working toward 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Feng Shui, watch for his fishing invitation. Take the purple marker west of Key Lento and win the challenge there; an ordinary fishing outing is not the objective.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Use your home TV controllers in Chapter 1 for one of the three home titles, or find a Bang For Your Buck cabinet. Finish every level of one title; optional challenges are unnecessary. If the home setup is temporarily inaccessible, return later.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy sends her Belville address. Follow Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, and Read the Label through to Puff Puff Pass. You can return to finish the chain after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After Island Dreams, look for Kenton’s KR marker in Key Lento. Work through all seven wreck assignments and turn in the finds, using the detector at the seabed. Kenton can disappear after Chapter 1; his work returns as the story progresses. Check Progress → Collections → Kenton’s Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, start Thrillbillies at the Mudclub in Kelly County. Follow with Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats and The Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes. Billy’s jobs can wait until free roam.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish whole stranger chains and check the PS5 trophy counter after each finale. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; it does not identify the other four required qualifying strands. Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not add to this counter. The open-world strands remain available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy’s Wish List opens in Chapter 3 after Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS and includes the story delivery. Check Map → Robberies → Randy’s Wish List; scan sports cars around Vice Beach or Ocean Beach and bring matches to the RK garage in west Vice City. The list stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: After Here, Kitty Kitty, switch to Jason and follow Vice City’s purple lab markers for Take Out Kitty Litter. Clear enough labs to get Tyrone’s follow-up and complete Spin On This. The required number of labs is not specified in the trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Before leaving Chapter 1, visit Jason’s kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth. When Lucia heads to the balcony, follow and accept her meditation invite. Later, meditate with both characters at each regular spot after Coffee Break; the final marker is at Mount Kalaga’s summit. Track entries in Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations.
trophies.warning: Potentially missable: the balcony session disappears after Chapter 1. It adds one to the counter, but whether it is required for this trophy is unknown. The 100% checklist only needs 15.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, use Jason and watch for Bret’s text. Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, then deliver animals from the purple Target Deck markers. The exact trophy-triggering animal is unknown; all 15 decks are needed for 100%, so work through them for both goals.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Start with short sets like Backyard Wrestling (12 cards) and Delights Dancers (18). Check wall boxes outdoors and surfaces indoors; different color variants count, duplicates do not. Selling cards keeps the collection credit. Track each set under Progress → Collections → Collectible Cards; 100% needs 15 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK camera (hold Up, then hold R1) on landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Explore on foot to catch nearby scan prompts. Check Progress → Collections → Waink Locations. Vehicle scans have a separate counter.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Leave most of this for cleanup. Check Progress → Challenges for the completed marks after your other trophy runs. Pick the quickest unfinished items; only 50 count toward this bronze, although 100% needs 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Unlock partner free roam after Coffee Break. The Chapter 4 café job that introduces bank vaults gives you a four-star escape with your partner. Leaving the flashing search area is only the first step; stay together until clear of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner after Coffee Break. PowerPyx suggests the three north Vice City jewelers that open after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs. Keep the flashing wanted indicator active between all three stores. Give the trophy time to register before assuming the run failed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan passing traffic with WAiNK rather than getting into every vehicle. Move between neighborhoods and scan boats or aircraft for variety. Progress → Vehicles shows discoveries by class; keep collecting base models for the separate 200-scan completion goal.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build Focus with the shooting ranges first. In an in-game gang encounter, trigger Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming and register five takedowns before the purple meter runs out. Multiple activations do not add together.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, choose a passenger jet attached to a jet bridge (E3/E4 is the example). Enter the cockpit, take off and fly roughly a kilometer away. An airliner parked away from the terminal does not satisfy the same trigger.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: In free roam, find a Rhino on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwestern Mariana County island. Get inside and use the tank against in-game enemies until the notification appears.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, visit Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds. Use the in-game Snap Gun prompt at the rear entrance, find the safe code in the back room and take the contents. Interact with the alarm and security recording before leaving unnoticed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Do the Chapter 4 café introduction, That’s Where The Money Is…, for the first vault. Complete Yasmani’s Payday Loans jobs to unlock his security-van tips. Take your partner on the large-bank jobs and check the map markers for cleared vaults. Continue to all eight for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Use the introductory vault job, That’s Where The Money Is…, in Chapter 4. The vault loot in that mission counts toward this trophy; finish the getaway beyond the heat radius before checking for the unlock.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Take an aircraft over still-dark sections of the map. Sweep the interior and the coastline in passes, then check for isolated patches that the first route missed. The unlock is tied to removing map fog.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Look for yellow operation markers and take every key valuable at one location per gang. Verify which gangs still have no cleared operation in Progress → Gangs. Platinum cleanup overlaps with 100%, which asks for all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and drink it beside the counter. Buying the drink is only the setup; consume it at the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get the Key Cloner in Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS. Use it on the showroom’s blue Banshee in south Vice City, then drive straight through the glass and continue down the street. The other showroom cars do not count.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, collect the watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 in the northeast and the safe contents in the northeast hallway office. Escape afterward. If the Chapter 2 visit is over, wait for the operation to respawn; separate visits count.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break unlocks partner free roam, take both characters to the gym. While you train one, the partner trains too. Check each character’s Strength stat under Jason & Lucia and keep training until both are at maximum.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Turn on the Criminal Profile HUD notification and let the count build through ordinary jobs. Stealthy completions and clean escapes can also affect the profile. Check the PlayStation trophy tracker for progress toward 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: After Credit Check, return to the prologue’s Little Cuba Payday Loans as Lucia alone. Collect the contents of all three drawers and escape the in-game search on foot. A vehicle getaway does not match the trophy’s trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Go alone to the road northwest of Starlet Motel after 2 a.m. Look for a blinking car; if it has not appeared, leave and try again. Follow the path into the woods, offer help after the UFO encounter and return with the woman to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use a bike’s Square melee action in-game. PowerPyx reports a target of ten pedestrian hits in one minute; Ocean Beach has enough NPCs nearby for one attempt. A collision alone is not a melee hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check in Chapter 3 unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer and the jobs that supply marked bills. Bring the bills to a fence such as Yasmani. The total accumulates across deliveries, so let the 100% bank circuit do most of this work.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Buy upgrades you actually want and let the spending total accumulate. Vehicle mods, weapons and tattoos are good places to put spare cash. Budget separately for the $160,000 garage set.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open Vice City Real Estate on the phone. Buy all eight listings, costing $160,000 together. The four garages awarded by the story are separate; the purchased parking slots also help with On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 Moses mission to install Scooter Bros and buy enough garage space. Drive inexpensive vehicles without trackers to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register. In Chapter 3, Pay ’n’ Spray can also register standard-tracker vehicles.
